content.text:
I reviewed the transcript against the answer key and the record. Here is my grading.

**Pairings:** Record items 1–11 all map cleanly to key items, in a different order than the key (7↔i4, 8↔i3, 10↔i7, 11↔i6). All figures, owners and due dates in the record match the meeting's final versions — including the corrected UTMA plan ($19,000 in 2026), the reassignment of the Imogen call from Priya to Owen, the Oyelaran deadline moved from Friday the 18th to Wednesday the 30th, and retirement at 63 rather than 60 or 62.

**Gaps:** Two key items are missing entirely — the father's September 22 hip surgery / will revision (e3), and the account action to change the contingent beneficiaries to Nora 50% / trust 50% once the trust is signed (a3). Record 7 covers only the paraplanner's *preparation* of the forms (i4), not the designation change itself, and one record item can capture only one key item.

**Correctly excluded:** None of the five NOT ACTIONS (condo, survivorship policy, corporate co-trustee, UTMA spend-down, conservative model switch) appear as actions. The record correctly avoided the stale $46,000 figure and the spend-down it implied.

**No extra items** — every record item is paired.

key_items.note: Record 1 captures the 18th birthday on February 11, 2027. Date matches the transcript. The key item's SSI/guardianship consequences are not spelled out, but the event and date are right.
Record 2 captures the Harrowdale Garden Supply job starting August 2026. Carries no figures, so nothing to contradict the twelve hours a week or the weekly job coach.

No record item captures the father's hip replacement on Tuesday September 22, 2026 or his redoing of the will with a gift to each grandchild. This is the driver behind action item i3 and it is absent.

Record 3 has the $19,000 UTMA-to-ABLE contribution. Correctly uses the final $19,000 (not the $20,000 limit and not the abandoned $46,000-based plan). Missing the December 31, 2026 deadline and the cash-option detail, but no wrong figure.

Record 4 captures the remaining UTMA balance going to the ABLE. Amount is NOT_FOUND rather than the ~$18,600 Celia stated after the correction, so it omits a figure but does not carry a wrong one. The January 2027 timing is also omitted.

No record item captures the actual beneficiary change to Nora 50% / special needs trust 50% on the 401(k), rollover IRA, Owen's $1.5M term and Priya's $500K term once the trust is signed. Record 7 is already paired with i4 (preparing the forms) and cannot also stand for this.
Record 5 matches: ABLE plan comparison plus the application, Deshawn Pellow, due September 25, 2026, which is the 'end of next week' agreed in the meeting.
Record 6 correctly reflects the late reassignment from Priya to Owen at 00:25:47 and the 'tomorrow morning' due date of September 16, 2026. Both the signing and guardianship meeting are included.
Record 8 matches: Celia Tranmere sending Femi Oyelaran the trust name and gift language, due September 30, 2026. Correctly uses the revised date, not the original Friday September 18.

Record 7 matches: Deshawn preparing change forms for all four accounts, due within a week of the trust signing. Omits the detail that he will walk Owen through the 401(k) HR portal change, but the core task, owner and timing are right.
Record 9 matches: Priya calling Social Security in January 2027 to book the appointment around Miles's birthday.
Record 11 matches: Priya drafting the letter of intent, due December 8, 2026, which is the agreed 'before we meet in December' date after the December 1 conflict with the IEP meeting.
Record 10 matches: Celia rerunning projections with Owen retiring at 63, due December 8, 2026. Uses the final age 63, not the prior plan's 60 or the 62 Owen had mentioned to Priya.
